items.title: Review: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time never gets old
items.summary: Breath of the Wild changed everything. Two decades after The Legend of Zelda made the transformational shift to 3D, Breath of the Wild reinvigorated the franchise with an open-ended adventure that was built around player freedom and expression. items.title: Review: ‘The Beginning of the End of Trumpism’
items.summary: “People hate the way that Trump is running this country,” the columnist Michelle Goldberg argues. Her fellow columnists and the American electorate agree. Democrats had a great night, but what now? Eight Opinion columnists offer their views on what Democrats need to do next, and what Trump’s final two years in office might hold.

items.title: Review: For ‘Dune: Part Three,’ Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya and Friends Weigh in on the Trilogy
items.summary: As Denis Villeneuve’s blockbuster series concludes, the cast recalls dealing with desert shoots and wrestling with the story’s moral implications.

items.title: Review: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
items.summary: As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.

items.title: Review: These 9 candidates for governor just made history
items.summary: Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.
